reviews.title: Almost could’ve burnt my house down
reviews.text: So I was using this app and I wanted to make an mug cake I didn’t want to use eggs so I asked it to generate me a recipe and it didn’t specify measurements or cook time so I asked my sister to help me. She gave me the measurements and the cook time and I put it in the microwave and I put it in for two minutes and at the 10 second mark it started smoking toxic fumes please work on your app

reviews.title: Different websites
reviews.text:
4.1.2026 - this app uses multiple websites, but a lot of those sites im not fond of. So this app is a no for me. 

It is very detailed with the types of food you have on hand, which is good.

reviews.title: Not great for a restricted diet
reviews.text: I have a super restrictive diet due to GERD. I had hoped plugging in every last thing I’m able to eat I’d get a large variety of different meal ideas. It gave me 5k of them all breakfast basically. I did get 22 horrible dinner ideas after adding some foods I’m not totally sure I can eat yet. Same for lunch just a handful of not awesome meals. It’s easier to just google recipes and omit what I don’t have.

reviews.title: App wouldn’t load recipes
reviews.text: I really wanted to like the app because it would be super great from what I saw, but every time I tried to load a full recipe it would get stuck.
